gaps.explanation: happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: He stopped ___ coffee before bed and now sleeps much better.
gaps.explanation: 'Stop doing' = quit the activity; 'stop to drink' would mean pause in order to drink.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: We're thinking of ___ to the coast for the weekend.
Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.

gaps.sentence: I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.
